name: Carataunas (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Carataunas (a tree, a tower and a mountain on white).
history: Municipal flag of Carataunas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Carataunas arms — tree, tower and mountain
